criteria.criterion: F1-F3 are corrected without weakening transport or identity boundaries
criteria.evidence: F1: test_paper_submission_coordinator.py now allowlists 'paper/recovery.py' with a comment citing RecoveryTransport's token+balance+daily-order-only scope (matches recovery.py:27-35's allowed set, unchanged and still fail-closed). F3: paper_reconciliation.py match_failure_fields wraps only the dispatch_claimed_at branch's _row_order_datetime() call in try/except ValueError, setting dispatch_time=False on parse failure instead of raising; all identity fields (date/symbol/side/quantity/price/original_order via is_original_order) are still required to match, and is_original_order is a strictly bounded '' or 1-16-ASCII-zero regex (rejects full-width zero, '0.0', '-0', 17 zeros), already accepted by the parent review's identity criterion. criteria.criterion: F4 correction wiring preserves pending history and never requeues uncertain deliveries
criteria.evidence: apply_recovery (recovery.py:194-208) calls enqueue_recovery_report inside the same reentrant store.transaction() as the recovery_applied audit, under recovery_locks held for the whole apply call. enqueue_recovery_report (reporting.py:265-283) only UPDATEs outbox rows WHERE state='pending' to state='superseded' (rows kept, not deleted) and is idempotent via an outbox id keyed on valuation_invalidated_before; it never touches state='delivery_unknown' rows. test_recovery_report_supersedes_only_pending_and_is_idempotent and the end-to-end test_apply_itself_supersedes_pending_report_and_preserves_unknown_delivery both assert a 'delivery_unknown' row stays 'delivery_unknown' after apply_recovery, and a second enqueue call at a later timestamp returns the same key with no duplicate pending row. Both pass.

criteria.criterion: F5 quarantines preopen and carried holdings while entries remain paused
criteria.evidence: recovery.py:187-192 now uses `session is None or not session.trading(now) or carried`, where Session.trading is `opens <= now < closes` (calendar.py:22-23) - covers pre-open, after-close, and non-trading days, and `carried` is computed independently from session.trading(now) so a position opened on a prior date is quarantined even when now IS mid-session. test_recovery_quarantines_preopen_and_carried_intraday_positions is parametrized over both cases (pre-open same-day, and 3-days-later mid-session with a carried position) and both assert quarantined==1 and control stays 'paused'; both pass.

criteria.criterion: F6 cannot publish a stale daily baseline as confirmed and protection remains available
criteria.evidence: valuation.py roll_baselines only marks day_base_valid True when the day is the profile's first session or when last_close_day equals calendar.previous_session_date(now) AND last_close_equity_valid is True; otherwise day_base still rolls forward but day_base_valid=False. reporting.py separates masking: valuation_incomplete (full mask) vs daily_pnl_incomplete = incomplete or not day_base_valid (masks only 당일 손익, not 누적/평가자산). runtime.py:151 sets no_entries=True whenever paper_trading and day_base_valid is falsy, so entries stay blocked on an unproven baseline; the reconciliation error path also now normalizes exc.detail to always contain an 'error' key before indexing it. test_stale_previous_close_masks_daily_pnl_until_a_valid_session_close exercises a stale last_close_day, confirms daily_pnl_incomplete=True while valuation_incomplete stays False, then confirms record_close(valid=True) + roll clears the mask and updates day_base; passes.

unresolvedRisks: Not re-verified in this bounded pass (explicitly out of scope per task instructions): full repository suite and `tach check`, which the parent runs independently in its configured venv.

Pre-existing operational risk carried from the parent receipt, unaffected by F1-F6: entry_reconciled now requires all(d['matched_rows']==1) over every queryable unresolved dispatch, so a genuinely lost broker POST that never appears in the daily-order window can hold apply_recovery at 'blocked' indefinitely with no documented manual escape path.

diagnose_match's 'near' filter (paper_reconciliation.py) compares row.order_number == dispatch.broker_order_reference without a None guard; if broker_order_reference is None and a broker row carries a null/empty order_number, it could appear in diagnostics' failure_fields list. This only affects human-facing diagnostics text, not the reconciliation decision itself (which uses the separately-computed strict matched_rows), so it is not a safety defect.
